stem: Magnesium (atomic number 12) reacts with chlorine (atomic number 17). Which statement correctly describes the electron transfer and the formula of the compound?

stem: A factory has an enriched sulphide ore of zinc, ZnS. Which sequence of steps will give zinc metal?

Roasting in limited air to ZnCO3, then heating alone
